class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackMedia
class.description: Pulls decoded audio from the [MediaSource]'s ring buffer. [method AudioStreamPlayback.seek], and [method AudioStreamPlayback.start] with a position above 0, seek the source (video included), unless the source's audio is already within 50 ms of that position: [code]AudioStreamPlayer.play(t)[/code] right after [method MediaSource.seek] costs no second seek. It stops playing when the source has read its last audio and the buffer is empty.
